text: Why choose to study this program? This programme offers students a thorough grounding in electrical and electronic engineering. Students will learn to operate at the cutting edge of emerging technologies. By the time you graduate, you should: have extensive experience in modelling and analytical methods; be able to use IT tools and CAD systems for modelling, analysis, simulation and design; be able to design a system, component or process based on initial requirements and constraints. What will I study? At level 1, you will acquire fundamental knowledge and practical skills, through the study of modules in:electronic circuits – transistors and amplifiers;C and C++ programming and software engineering;engineering mathematics;electromagnetism and drives;digital electronics;integrated electronics and design At level 2, you will build on this foundation and learn about:continuous and discrete time signals and systems;CMOS Integrated Circuits;microprocessor systems;communications principles;instrumentation;RF engineering and applied electromagnetics;energy conversion and power systems;control systems In your final year, you will undertake a substantial research project, spanning both semesters. You will also learn about:analogue and digital communications;digital design with; HDL;signal processing; electronics for instrumentation; embedded computer systems; digital filtering;optoelectronics and photonics
